_description: Monetization switches read by build.py. Leave a value empty to keep that feature off.
adsense_note: Set to your AdSense publisher id (ca-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) after approval. build.py then injects the AdSense script on every page (Auto ads) and writes ads.txt.
ads_txt_note: Paste the ads.txt line AdSense gives you, e.g. google.com, pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0
affiliate_disclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you buy through them, 404 Memory Found may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. We only link to things we would look for ourselves.
google_verification_note: Search Console → Settings → Ownership verification → HTML tag: paste only the content value.
bing_verification_note: Bing Webmaster Tools → Add site → HTML meta tag: paste only the content value of msvalidate.01.
pinterest_verification_note: Pinterest business settings → Claimed accounts → Website → Add HTML tag: paste only the content value of p:domain_verify.
affiliates_note: Affiliate partners chosen in the 9 Sep 2026 study (AFFILIATES.md). Paste the id the network gives you into 'id' (and 'merchant_id' where the template needs one). build.py then rewrites every link to that partner's domains with tracking and marks it rel=sponsored; until then the links stay plain and nofollow. Templates may use {url}, {url_encoded}, {path}, {id}, {merchant_id}. A partner with 'param' instead of a template gets ?param=id appended.

affiliates.name: Etsy (Awin)
affiliates.note: id = your Awin publisher id. Etsy's Awin merchant id is 6220. Use for artifacts, toys, mall-era ephemera.

affiliates.name: ScanMyPhotos (Awin)
affiliates.note: Same Awin publisher id as Etsy; paste ScanMyPhotos' merchant id from the Awin dashboard. Use for photo, negative and slide posts.

affiliates.name: Legacybox / Southtree / Kodak Digitizing (ShareASale)
affiliates.note: id = ShareASale user id; merchant_id from the merchant page after approval. Use for VHS, camcorder and home-video posts.

affiliates.name: Stone Age Gamer
affiliates.note: Confirm the tracking parameter name in your approval email; 'ref' is a placeholder. Use for flash carts, repro cartridges and console mods.

affiliates.name: Anbernic (UpPromote)
affiliates.note: UpPromote links use ?sca_ref=<id>; paste the full ref value. Use for modern-retro handheld posts.

affiliates.name: GOG
affiliates.note: id = your GOG affiliate id. Use for 90s and 2000s PC game posts.

affiliates.name: Humble Bundle (Impact)
affiliates.note: Impact issues per-publisher tracking links; paste the full template Impact gives you with {url_encoded} where the deep link goes.

affiliates.name: Green Man Gaming (Impact)
affiliates.note: Impact tracking template, same as Humble.

affiliates.name: Displate
affiliates.note: Verify the real rate inside the program before writing about it.

affiliates.name: Walmart (Impact)
affiliates.note: Impact tracking template. Use where the modern reissue is in stock at a big-box store.

affiliates.name: Amazon Associates
affiliates.note: Fallback layer only. Do not apply until the site can produce 3 orders in 180 days, or the account is closed for good.

social_profiles_note: Public profiles of the publication (Pinterest, X, YouTube, etc.). Rendered as Organization.sameAs on the about page so answer engines can ground the entity. Add the Pinterest profile URL here.
